findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the following require repairs:

(1) The mop sink must be sealed to the wall. 

(2) The bathroom ceiling and door trim must be sealed to the wall (eliminate the large gaps). 

Ensure that the above referenced are sealed to the wall to make smooth, easily cleanable surfaces by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Hand sink and mop sink in the room with the ice machine both need caulked to the wall (no caulk). Bare wood that the hand sink is attached to needs painted and/or sealed to be smooth and easily cleanable.
2. Interior of cabinets under the fountain soda machine and coffee makers need painted and/or sealed with clear coat - smooth and easily cleanable surfaces (not exposed wood).
3. Bathroom needs ceiling trim re-caulked to the wall. It is coming away around the entire perimeter of the bathroom.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before next routine inspection.
